Q: How can I use "\s+" as a read_csv seperator in polars? A:

If you only have spaces separated by a blank space, you should use the following command

pl.read_csv(file_dir, skip_rows=1, separator=' ')

Q: C/C++ standard string conversion functions don't support binary string literals? A:

Turns out it's due to an outdated version of glibc, both on my computer and in the linked Godbolt examples. I updated the post with my notes on that. Thanks for all the help!

Q: Python openpyxl reads float value incorrectly A:

Openpyxl read a value as float when it detects numbers with comma or dot, so the value has the float inaccuracy. To use Decimal doesnt resolve it because the data has the float inaccuracy.
My solution is convert data in csv and read them in python.
